P.name: Dragon Practice
P.title: Template:Data Smolder/Dragon Practice
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Dragon Practice|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Smolder
|skill        = I
|icon         = Smolder Dragon Practice.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Smolder''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|''Dragon Practice''|buzzword3}} each time he hits an enemy champion with an {{tip|ability}}, or whenever ''{{ai|Super Scorcher Breath|Smolder}}'' kills a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}. His basic abilities deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on stacks.
* ''{{ai|Q|Smolder}}'': Deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{critical damage|25 to 55|0 to 30|critScaling=true}} {{as|of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.
* ''{{ai|W|Smolder}}'': Explosions deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|55% of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.
* ''{{ai|E|Smolder}}'': Attacks each deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{critical damage|8 to 12.8|0 to 4.8|critScaling=true}} {{as|of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self/Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = proc
|spellshield  = true
|parry        = true
|notes        = 
* {{ai|Super Scorcher Breath|Smolder}} grants a stack if the target dies while the initial missile is in flight.
** This happens even if the target dies to {{ais|Super Scorcher Breath 3|Smolder|Super Scorcher Breath}} burn, giving him a total of 2 stacks.
* {{ai|Achooo!|Smolder}} can only grant a stack of {{as|Dragon Practice|buzzword3}} with the first hit against each enemy champion.
* {{ai|Flap, Flap, Flap|Smolder}} can only grant one stack of {{as|Dragon Practice|buzzword3}} per cast.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurbicon    = Smolder Dragon Practice.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Smolder}} generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Dragon Practice'' from damaging champions with abilities, or when ''{{ai|Super Scorcher Breath|Smolder}}'' kills {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}. His {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on stacks.
}}

E.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
E.title: Template:Data Smolder/Flap, Flap, Flap
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Flap, Flap, Flap|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Smolder
|skill        = E
|icon         = Smolder Flap, Flap, Flap.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' takes flight for {{fd|1.25}} seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|{{as|75% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|unobstructed vision}}, and the ability to ignore terrain collision. While in flight, he automatically fires up to 5 {{as|(+ 1 per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} bolts at the nearest and {{tt|most wounded|Lowest health percent}} {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} with each hit and prioritizing enemy champions.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage per Hit|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 30% AD)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Total Physical Damage|{{ap|10*5 to 30*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*5}}% AD)}}}}
|description2 = ''Flap, Flap, Flap'' ends immediately if '''Smolder''' casts another ability or becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}.
|range        = 700
|speed        = {{tt|1800|Bolt speed}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cooldown     = {{ap|24 to 16}}
|cast time    = none
|cost         = 65
|costtype     = mana
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = physical
|spelleffects = spell
|spellshield  = special
|parry        = false
|grounded     = true
|notes        =
* The number of additional bolts based on {{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}} stacks is rounded down.
* '''Smolder''' reveals himself while attacking enemies, even inside terrain.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block only one bolt.
* Self {{tip|immobilize|immobilizations}} such as {{ii|Zhonya's Hourglass}} also count for ending ''Flap, Flap, Flap''.
* {{si|Recall}} is disabled while '''Smolder''' is inside terrain.
* ''Flap, Flap, Flap'' can interact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
* If '''Smolder''' is inside terrain when the effect ends, he will be placed correspondingly to the nearest valid space.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Smolder''' is flying:
{{ct|attack=Causes '''Smolder''' to move towards the attack target.|cast=interrupts|move=true|items==true,,interrupts|spells=true|interrupts=death,root}}

|blurbicon    = Smolder Flap, Flap, Flap.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Smolder}} takes flight for a short time, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and the ability to ignore terrain collision.
